column1: # Per-game settings for the Apple IIgs Game Bub core. tools/mkgamedb.py turns
# this into gamedb.bin. Tab-separated; "-" = default. Lookup key: the WOZ
#   input    - | mouse | keyboard              (mode at start; Select toggles)
#   buttons  button=key;...  buttons a b x y l r start; keys as in mkgamedb.py
#            KEYS (return, space, esc, up, oa, option, a..z, 0..9, none, ...).
#            Unlisted buttons keep the defaults: a=return b=space x=esc y=y
#            l=oa r=option start=return. In mouse mode A is the mouse button.
